get_public_ip.body:
# Uses curl to fetch and display your public IP address.
curl ifconfig.me

dil-cdk-deploy.body: DIL_CDK_SCOPE=sud aws-vault exec dil-boardeffect-dev -- npx cdk deploy PipelineDev/Deploy-dev-us-west-2/SharedInfra

dil-cdk-destroy.body: DIL_CDK_SCOPE=sud aws-vault exec dil-boardeffect-dev -- npx cdk destroy PipelineDev/Deploy-dev-us-west-2/SharedInfra

git_clean_branches.body:
# Deletes all local branches that have been merged into the current branch,
# except for 'main' and 'develop'.
git branch --merged | grep -v 'main$' | grep -v 'develop$' | grep -v 'master$' | xargs -n 1 git branch -d
